risk_note: RV2 (risk, with identity and linking through injected ports). PUT /admin/v1/users/{user_id}/risk-state: ban / unban need risk.ban and freeze / unfreeze need risk.freeze, all with totp step-up; body checks (reason 1–200, reason_category only for ban / freeze, frozen_until only for freeze and later than now); state rules from the contract (appealing 44004, banned cannot be frozen directly); expected_row_version CAS where null only creates the first record (20902 user_risk_state). In one transaction under the user lock (users FOR NO KEY UPDATE, the same lock as F1-07c's binding writes, taken before setRiskState): ban revokes every session and refresh token and blocks the union bindings (admin_disable kept), unban restores ban-blocked bindings (Taobao invalid, other alliances active; BR-ID-31 / BR-ID-20 at SPEC_REF b90e712 after the owner decision of 2026-10-18), freeze / unfreeze leave sessions and bindings; audit; risk.state_changed in the same transaction. Cross-process cache invalidation through a monotonic Redis version stamp (written before and after commit, baseline on cache fill, a missing key or a database read below the watermark is never cached; a stamp write failure rolls the change back with 50001); Redis is optional so the frozen B1-03h cache tests keep the local behaviour. No withdrawal row is written; the in-app message RISK_STATE_CHANGED is left to the notification module (TODO). Accepted residual risk as recorded in the ledger. Operation leaves planned; route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
